title: Opportunity bridges + gap ledger: seed examples (W15c, hand-verified from the demo pack and 17 Oct re-checks)
definition: A bridge links one company or project to one counterparty (buyer, partner, funder, programme, port or research infrastructure), with evidence on both sides, a date or deadline, one action and a confidence.

bridge_types.won_before_open_again: TED award by business ID + an open tender in the same class
bridge_types.already_works_with: CORDIS or Interreg co-participation, so a pilot or reference route already exists
bridge_types.rule_decides: a grant rule decides the tier for this company's registration country, stage or type
bridge_types.proof_step: a fundable validation step (test facility, access programme) for this technology class
bridge_types.law_creates_buyer: a regulation with a date creates buyers for this capability
bridge_types.programme_fit: an accelerator or ecosystem programme fits this company now
bridge_types.lab_window: a public research project nearing its end, with no company yet: spin-out window
